source.title: The Legend of Zelda™: Ocarina of Time
source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 10Animated Blood, Fantasy ViolenceGamesThe Legend of Zelda™: Ocarina of TimeReleases 11/5/26VersionNintendo Switch 2Select an editionDigital - The Legend of Zelda™: Ocarina of TimeAnimated Blood, Fantasy ViolenceLoadingTake up your sword and embark on a grand adventure!Gameplay of the trailer for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time begins as glowing fireflies hover gently across the screen.Play The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time trailer.A classic tale, built from the ground up for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system.Watch the trailerWatch the trailerThe battle for Hyrule beginsThe evil Ganondorf is scheming to steal the mythical Triforce from the Sacred Realm and take over the world. Now Link must become the Hero of Time and save the kingdom in the Legend of Zelda™: Ocarina of Time game, exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2.Link is the only member of the Kokiri who doesn't have a fairy, until the Great Deku Tree asks Navi to accompany him in his adventures. Fairies often have helpful hints to share—if you see any on this page, be sure to see what they have to say!LinkThe young hero of the story, accompanied by his trusty fairy, Navi. ZeldaThe young princess of Hyrule seeking to protect her kingdom.GanondorfThe menacing leader of the Gerudo, who harbors ambitions to seize the Triforce.LinkZeldaGanondorfPrevious gallery itemNext gallery itemActive gallery item: 1 of 3.Hear Navi's VoiceThe legend reborn for a new generationEnjoy completely overhauled visuals, orchestral music, voice acting, and expanded cutscenes. Jump and dash through the action with enhanced controls and modern camera movements, making this a great entry point into this legendary series.Unlock the power of the ocarinaLink’s ocarina may appear to be an ordinary musical instrument, but if played correctly, can wield incredible magical powers.Play Video.Play Video.Previous gallery itemNext gallery itemActive gallery item: 1 of 2.Play Video.You can play Link’s Fairy Ocarina or the Ocarina of Time with traditional button controls or try humming, or even playing your own instruments into the Nintendo Switch 2 microphone! The songs Link learns to play on his ocarina have all kinds of effects, like opening new paths, changing day to night, and more.Lore and moreLearn a little more about the story and local lore with these new features!Previous gallery itemNext gallery itemItem 1 of 4.Listen to new and expanded dialog from characters big and small.A series of gameplay moments scrolls across the screen from right to left. Help Link become the Hero of TimeDuring his epic journey to save the kingdom, our young hero becomes much more powerful—and so does his equipment!Gameplay of a young Link using his strength to pull up the Master Sword before transforming into adult Link. autoplay video descriptionYoung LinkHe may be small, but young Link’s kid-sized weapons help him take on foes twice his size.Adult LinkAs Link grows older, he gains the ability to wield the legendary Master Sword, along with other useful tools to help him on his quest. Young LinkAdult LinkKokiri SwordDeku ShieldFairy SlingshotDeku StickKokiri SwordThis small, child-sized sword is a treasure of Kokiri Forest.Item 1 of 4.Ranged weapons like the Fairy Bow and the Hookshot can be aimed through button controls or through motion controls. You can customize that in the Options menu.Explore the kingdom of HyruleWhether you’re a first-time visitor or a seasoned adventurer, you’ll want to explore every corner of this fabled land—you never know who you might meet!Lon Lon RanchHyrule CastleKokiri ForestZora’s RiverGoron CityKakariko VillageLon Lon RanchHyrule CastleKokiri ForestZora’s RiverGoron CityKakariko VillageLon Lon RanchLon Lon RanchThe cows at this farm are famous for their rejuvenating milk, but the ranch’s prized horses are the real reason to visit. Hyrule CastleHyrule CastleThis majestic palace is home to the royal family, including Princess Zelda. The castle is only accessible by official invitation (unless you can find another way in). Just south of the stronghold lies Hyrule Castle Town, a lively village full of shops and friendly locals.Kokiri ForestKokiri ForestThe green and woodsy home of Link and the peaceful Kokiri, childlike folk who never grow old, along with their trusty fairies. They live in the shade of the Great Deku Tree, their wise and ancient guardian.Zora’s RiverZora’s RiverFollow Zora’s River to the waterfall and play a specific tune on your ocarina to gain entrance to the enchanting land of the Zora—the proud, fishlike folk who rule the waters of Hyrule.Goron CityGoron CityJust up the hill from Kakariko Village (right below fiery Death Mountain) is Goron City, home of the hard-working, rock-eating Gorons.Kakariko VillageKakariko VillageOn the way to the Death Mountain Trail lies the small town of Kakariko Village, home to many colorful characters. Gear up for adventureExplore Hyrule in style with this special edition Nintendo Switch 2 system.Learn moreTap into fun with amiiboGet in-game extras to help you on your adventure by tapping any Legend of Zelda series amiibo™ figure**. If you tap the new Young Link and Young Zelda amiibo figures, you’ll get in-game masks that evoke a retro graphical style!Shop for amiiboThe Legend of Zelda 40th AnniversaryLearn about the history of the series and upcoming events at the official home of The Legend of Zelda.Start exploringAvailable 11/5Exclusively on Nintendo Switch 2Back to top*Nintendo Account, compatible smart device and persistent internet required. Nintendo Switch Online membership (sold separately) required for certain features. Not available in all countries. Data charges may apply. source.title: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy: Encore Edition
source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 8Language, Mild Blood, Mild Suggestive Themes, Use of Alcohol, ViolenceGamesMarvel's Guardians of the Galaxy: Encore EditionReleases 11/5/26VersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalSale ends: 11/5/26 at 07:59 a.m. UTCLanguage, Mild Blood, Mild Suggestive Themes, Use of Alcohol, ViolenceLoadingThe critically-acclaimed, story-driven Marvel adventure, now optimized for Nintendo Switch™ 2Fire up a wild ride across the cosmos with a fresh take on Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy. In this action-adventure game, you are Star-Lord leading the unpredictable Guardians from one explosion of chaos to the next. You got this. Probably.The Encore Edition is exclusive to Switch 2 and includes a new set of outfits for Star-Lord, Drax, Gamora, Rocket and Groot. Dressed in 1980s glam rock threads, the Guardians are ready to bring down the house. Literally.OPTIMIZED FOR SWITCH 2Whether you’re playing at home or taking the galaxy with you on the go, expect smooth performance, refined controls, and seamless handheld play. TAKE THE LEADBecome Star-Lord and call the shots for the Guardians in and out of battle.ALL-NEW STORYFace a cosmic threat you unleashed in this fresh take on Guardians of the Galaxy, the winner of Best Narrative at The Game Awards 2021.BECOME FAMILYTurn your band of outlaws into legendary heroes on a wild ride across space.Software description provided by the publisher.About this itemGame file size (estimated)45 GBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership.
